request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Recolour only the red parts: the red body panels of the buggy become mismatched scrap metal, some dull gunmetal grey #6d7684 and some rusted iron #8a4a2a, with one small panel of hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes; the driver's red cap becomes dull brown leather #955627. No red left. Keep the buggy's shape, ram, wheels, exhaust and soot cloud, the driver, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
